_comment: Which region an area export reads its archives from: the region with heights holding the centre of the box [west, south, east, north], else the first one touching it, else null. Made-up boxes over NSW and the simulated regions. Read by shared/src/areaExport.test.ts (areaExportRegion) and topo/tests/test_regions.py (TestExportRegion), so the API that names the grid and the worker that reads the archives cannot pick differently.

cases.why: centre off NSW's northern border, the box over it
centre off NSW's western border, the box over it
inside the heights' coverage box and all in Victoria
centre past simulated Utah's east edge, the box over it
